boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Indiana Wesleyan University-Marion
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Marion food destinations with late hours verified on current official location pages; confirm hours before leaving because operators may change them.

cards.title: IHOP After Midnight
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour dining room on South Western Avenue
cards.notes: Choose this all-night option when other kitchens have closed, and check the location page before traveling on holidays or during severe weather.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock, sit-down option for pancakes, omelets, burgers, and takeout.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official Marion location page lists the restaurant at 3038 South Western Avenue as open 24 hours every day, with dine-in and takeout available.
cards.source_title: Marion Late Night Food - IHOP® Late Night Food in 46953
cards.access_notes: Official hours show 24-hour operation Monday through Sunday. The page lists dine-in, curbside pickup, online ordering, delivery, and takeout; verify holiday conditions before departure.

cards.title: South-Side Taco Bell Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: Drive-thru service until 5 a.m. on South Western Avenue
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest posted service window; do not assume the dining room follows the same schedule shown for vehicles.
cards.short_summary: An overnight drive-thru whose official schedule extends well beyond midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page for 3244 South Western Avenue lists drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–5 a.m. daily and identifies the location as open late.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Marion, IN - 3244 S Western Ave
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists drive-thru service from 9 a.m. to 5 a.m. every day. Dine-in hours are separate and may end earlier, so use the drive-thru late at night.

cards.title: North Baldwin Taco Bell Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: A second drive-thru scheduled until 5 a.m.
cards.notes: Select this Baldwin Avenue branch when its location is convenient, and rely on the drive-thru schedule rather than assuming lobby access.
cards.short_summary: A northern Marion counterpart with the same posted overnight drive-thru window.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page for 916 North Baldwin Avenue lists drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–5 a.m. seven days a week and marks the restaurant open late.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Marion, IN - 916 N. Baldwin Ave.
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours are 9 a.m.–5 a.m. daily. The dining-room schedule is distinct and can end sooner; plan on vehicle access for the overnight window.

cards.title: Papa Johns Near Midnight
cards.subtitle: Delivery nightly and carryout as late as 12:45 a.m.
cards.notes: Place the order before the applicable delivery or carryout cutoff, and check the official page because weekend and weekday closing times differ.
cards.short_summary: A late pizza option with clearly separated delivery and carryout schedules.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns’ official Marion page lists delivery until midnight Monday–Thursday, 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 11 p.m. Sunday; carryout ends 15 minutes earlier on most nights.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns N Baldwin Ave | Papa Johns Marion, IN
cards.access_notes: Delivery closes at midnight Monday–Thursday, 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 11 p.m. Sunday. Carryout closes at 11:45 p.m., 12:45 a.m., or 11 p.m., respectively.

cards.title: Pizza Hut Until 11:30
cards.subtitle: A consistent late pizza window on North Baldwin Avenue
cards.notes: Order before 11:30 p.m. and select the service mode shown as available; delivery timing can vary even when the restaurant remains open.
cards.short_summary: Pizza, wings, pasta, and desserts with the same posted closing time all week.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official page for 939 North Baldwin Avenue lists restaurant hours of 10 a.m.–11:30 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut: Pizza & Wings - Delivery & Take Out From 939 N Baldwin Ave
cards.access_notes: The official page lists 10 a.m.–11:30 p.m. hours every day for the displayed service schedules and cautions that delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Wendy's
cards.subtitle: All-night restaurant and drive-thru service on State Route 18
cards.notes: Save this round-the-clock option for nights when timing is uncertain, but verify temporary closures before making the longer eastward trip.
cards.short_summary: The Marion Wendy’s location whose official page lists continuous daily operation.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page for the Pilot–Marion restaurant at 6252 State Route 18 East lists both restaurant and drive-thru hours as open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists the restaurant and drive-thru as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday. Check for temporary operational or holiday changes before leaving.

cards.title: South Wendy's at 11
cards.subtitle: Restaurant and drive-thru open until 11 p.m. daily
cards.notes: Head here before the posted 11 p.m. cutoff for a predictable nightly window, and place mobile orders early enough for preparation and pickup.
cards.short_summary: A South Western Avenue stop with an identical closing time seven nights a week.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page for 1410 South Western Avenue lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 a.m.–11 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant and drive-thru hours run from 6:30 a.m. to 11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Weekend Wendy's on Wabash
cards.subtitle: Open until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Reserve this option for Friday or Saturday before 11 p.m.; on Sunday through Thursday, the official schedule ends one hour earlier.
cards.short_summary: A weekend-oriented late stop with a shorter closing time on weeknights.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page for 1223 North Wabash Avenue lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru hours extend to 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday. Both close at 10 p.m. Sunday through Thursday.

cards.title: Friday-and-Saturday DQ Run
cards.subtitle: Food and frozen treats until 11 p.m. on weekends
cards.notes: Go before 11 p.m. on Friday or Saturday for the latest window; earlier in the week, check the page for the applicable 10 p.m. closing.
cards.short_summary: A weekend late-dessert stop that also serves a full Grill & Chill food menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Dairy Queen’s official page for 1204 South Baldwin lists store and delivery hours until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. on the other listed days.
cards.source_title: DQ Food and Treat in Marion, IN, 1204 S Baldwin
cards.access_notes: Official store and delivery hours end at 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday through Thursday. Online ordering availability can change near closing.

cards.title: Subway's 10 p.m. Window
cards.subtitle: Sandwiches, wraps, and salads until 10 p.m. nightly
cards.notes: Treat this as an early late-night run and arrive before 10 p.m.; submit online orders with enough lead time for preparation before closing.
cards.short_summary: A nightly 10 p.m. option when a customizable sandwich or salad fits the plan.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway’s official page for 3409 South Western Avenue lists store hours of 9 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Subway® at 3409 S. Western Avenue Marion IN
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists store hours from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m. every day. Ordering channels include pickup and delivery, subject to availability near closing.
